title: Step on only specific blocks
description: You'll die unless you step on specific blocks
body:
In this pack, we coded so that it will kill you instantly if you step on the wrong blocks.
# What's new?
It will cause 10000 damage of floor_is_lava if you miss to step on safe blocks.
(Go to the gallary to find safe blocks.)
No enchantments can prevent you from dying. Also, frost_walker boots will break in no time.
# Why I ever need this pack?
This datapack not only requires high survival skills, but also patience and precisely control of your character.
So for you, it's a great chance to prove and improve your skills if you beat the game.
#  If you want to play this datapack properly, follow these steps:
1.Enter the world with creative and cheating.
2.Find a water source with trees nearby.
3.place an **upper** slab and set world spawn point there.
4.Switch to survival mode and start playing.
**Or you'll repeat dying**
